name: App shell
anatomy: Brand, primary destinations, catalog search, help, current context, account.
states: Default, active destination, mobile navigation, loading context, access denied.
behavior: HSE: use a 64px starting header, stable navigation and a visible organization/site context. Collapse navigation when it no longer fits.
accessibility: Skip link, navigation labels, one main region, aria-current on the active route; preserve focus after navigation.

name: Mega menu and mobile navigation
anatomy: Desktop grouped headings and links; mobile nested rows with chevrons, Back and Close.
states: Closed, open, focused, expanded subsection, current destination.
behavior: HSE: ordinary navigation links in desktop disclosure; full-width mobile modal; do not hide essential destinations in unlabelled icons.
accessibility: aria-expanded on disclosure, Escape closes, focus returns to opener. Mobile modal contains focus; navigation is not an ARIA application menu.

name: Breadcrumbs
anatomy: Ordered ancestor links, separators, current location.
states: Full, collapsed ancestors, keyboard focused.
behavior: HSE: readable path with current page as text; keep a meaningful parent on mobile and expose hidden ancestors.
accessibility: Label the navigation Breadcrumbs; separators decorative; current page aria-current=page.

name: Search field and suggestions
anatomy: Label, text input, clear action, submit, popup with suggestion types.
states: Empty, entered, focused, suggestions, loading, no matches, request failure.
behavior: HSE: 44px minimum / 48px touch, preserved query, labelled result types; keyboard Enter searches, Escape closes popup. Exact and suggested results are distinct.
accessibility: Combobox semantics only when implemented; listbox options, aria-expanded/controls/activedescendant; announce result changes politely.

name: Filter toolbar and chips
anatomy: Filter action with count, facet triggers, removable applied chips, Clear all, result count.
states: Default, selected, open facet, focused, no results.
behavior: HSE: keep count visible and wrap applied chips below the toolbar. An individual removal preserves all other filters.
accessibility: Removal buttons name the filter; do not nest buttons inside buttons; selection cannot depend on color alone.

name: Filter drawer
anatomy: Title, Close, scrollable fieldsets/accordions, count, Clear, Show results.
states: Open, draft selection, applying, empty selection, error, dismissed.
behavior: HSE: 360px desktop starting width / full viewport mobile. Stage changes and commit on Show results; Escape and Cancel discard drafts. This differs from observed Coursera immediate URL updates.
accessibility: Modal dialog name, initial focus, Tab containment, Escape, restore trigger. Clear inert/aria-hidden on every close path including in-flight updates.

name: Buttons and action groups
anatomy: Verb label, optional leading/trailing icon, optional pending indicator.
states: Primary, secondary, tertiary, icon, destructive; default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading.
behavior: HSE: 44px default, 48px coarse pointer, 36px compact only for deliberate dense desktop contexts. One primary action per task group. Preserve button width during loading.
accessibility: Native button for mutation, anchor for navigation. Accessible name on icon actions. Visible focus. Disable duplicate submission and announce completion.

name: Links and section navigation
anatomy: Descriptive label; optional external-destination cue; current section indicator.
states: Default, hover, focus, active location, visited where appropriate.
behavior: HSE: underline inline links. Sticky section anchors scroll to content and respect header offset; they do not masquerade as tab panels.
accessibility: Accessible destination text; aria-current=location for current anchor. Keyboard focus cannot be covered by sticky bars.

name: Catalog card
anatomy: Optional image, owner, linked title, concise summary, duration/type, version, status.
states: Default, hover, focus-within, saved, unavailable, image fallback.
behavior: HSE: 16px corners/padding, 16:9 optional art, 14px metadata. Compact 64px image rows on mobile. Never truncate critical scope or restrictions.
accessibility: One primary linked title plus sibling actions. No nested interactive elements. Avoid redundant image alt when the same title is adjacent.

name: Collections and pagination
anatomy: Section title, result count, card list, optional See all / pagination controls.
states: First/last page, current page, more loading, empty collection, error.
behavior: HSE: use grids/lists for assigned work; reserve carousels for optional discovery. Keep query, filters, page and scroll position on Back.
accessibility: Label pagination and current page; expose list semantics; announce newly loaded range; all carousel content reachable without dragging.

name: Course detail header
anatomy: Breadcrumb, title, provider, outcomes, version, next action, scope.
states: Available, assigned, in progress, unavailable, superseded version.
behavior: HSE: 32/40px app title; 44/52 marketing display. Keep applicability/practical prerequisites near the main action; show the content version being used.
accessibility: One descriptive H1; logical heading sequence; long titles wrap; CTA is present in the meaningful document order.

name: Summary facts
anatomy: Label/value groups for duration, level, modules and outcome type.
states: Known, unknown, not applicable, warning/blocking.
behavior: HSE: use a definition list; stack on mobile. Replace consumer ratings with verified scope/version facts when those better support the task.
accessibility: Read label before value; explain unknowns; icons supplement text. Do not use unavailable values as zero.

name: Tabs
anatomy: Tablist, labelled tabs, active indicator, linked panel.
states: Selected, unselected, keyboard focused, disabled if justified.
behavior: HSE: Arrow keys/Home/End move focus; Enter/Space activates for manual tabs; activation and focus are distinct. My Learning showed manual-focus movement.
accessibility: tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, roving tabindex, aria-controls and aria-labelledby; only relevant panel is exposed.

name: Accordion and syllabus
anatomy: Heading trigger, summary/duration, chevron, content region, separate Preview/Start action.
states: Collapsed, expanded, focus, locked content with reason.
behavior: HSE: Enter/Space toggles; group related secondary details. Blocking prerequisites remain visible in the summary. Never nest Preview inside the expansion button.
accessibility: aria-expanded and aria-controls; meaningful headings and named region when useful; hide collapsed content from focus and accessibility.

name: Text input and textarea
anatomy: Visible label, optional helper, control, optional counter, inline error.
states: Empty, filled, focus, read-only, disabled, invalid, pending save.
behavior: HSE: 16px input text, 44px minimum; label above; preserve values after failure. Textarea grows or scrolls predictably.
accessibility: Label association, required semantics, aria-invalid and describedby for errors; errors explain recovery rather than color alone.

name: Checkbox, radio, select and switch
anatomy: Labelled options grouped by a legend; helper and optional count.
states: Unchecked/checked, indeterminate checkbox, focus, disabled, invalid.
behavior: HSE: checkbox for independent multiple choices; radio for one choice; select for long simple choices; switch only for immediate on/off settings. Label row is the hit target.
accessibility: Prefer native controls. Fieldset/legend, keyboard behavior, selected state announced; 44px label target. Counts are supplemental.

name: Badges and qualification states
anatomy: Explicit status text, optional icon, separate scope/expiry metadata.
states: Not started, pending, complete, passed, authorized, expired, revoked, unknown.
behavior: HSE: distinguish knowledge, site, practical, authorization and external credential milestones. All required gates must be met before authorization; missing data stays Unknown.
accessibility: Text is mandatory; distinguish states beyond hue. Do not make a noninteractive tag look like a clickable filter.

name: Alerts and inline notices
anatomy: Severity icon, concise title, explanation, recovery/help link, optional Close.
states: Information, success, warning, error; dismissible or persistent.
behavior: HSE: place task errors near task. A blocking warning names the missing prerequisite. Dismissible informational notices must not hide critical unresolved status.
accessibility: role=alert only for urgent new failures; status/polite for routine updates. Visible title and text; close has an accessible name and target.

name: Progress and assigned-learning card
coverage: HSE extension; populated Coursera card unverified
anatomy: Assignment, due date, progress value, current module, next action, qualification status.
states: Assigned, in progress, knowledge complete, blocked, overdue, stale save.
behavior: HSE: exact progress value and last saved status; assigned work precedes discovery. Progress never authorizes a worker.
accessibility: Native progress or progressbar with accessible value/name; text alternative; no rapid live announcements for every percentage.

name: Modal dialog
anatomy: Title, message/content, Close, primary and cancel actions.
states: Opening, open, busy, validation error, cancelled, closed.
behavior: HSE: use native dialog or tested primitive; width fits viewport; retain content on validation error; destructive actions name the exact object/scope.
accessibility: Accessible name; modal focus containment; Escape; restore focus; background not interactive. Test with async content and route changes.

name: Contextual rail and assistant
anatomy: Title, close/restore, supporting details or messages, citations, optional composer.
states: Collapsed, expanded, loading, response, error, unavailable.
behavior: HSE: collapsed by default; desktop rail only if main remains usable; mobile drawer. AI suggestions cannot approve evaluation or authorization.
accessibility: Nonmodal rail uses complementary landmark and does not trap focus. Label AI responses; updates polite; composer named; no unsolicited focus stealing.

name: Data table and sorting
anatomy: Caption, column headers, sort control, rows, scope/status, row action, pagination.
states: Default, sorted ascending/descending, selected rows, loading, empty, error.
behavior: HSE: use records table for comparisons; label bulk scope; preserve sorting/filter state; allow local horizontal scroll when relationships require it.
accessibility: Native table, th scope, aria-sort on sorted header, labelled region if scrollable. Avoid grid role without implementing its keyboard contract.

name: Qualification requirements
anatomy: Prerequisite label, state, evidence/version, responsible role, action, authorization summary.
states: Not assessed, required, pending, satisfied, failed, not applicable, revoked.
behavior: HSE: conditional requirement set from applicability model; show why blocked and who can resolve it. External credentials may satisfy a prerequisite; stages are not universally linear.
accessibility: List semantics; explicit status and next action; status changes announced after save. Do not hide reasons in hover-only tooltips.

name: Evidence upload
anatomy: File picker, requirements, file list, progress, per-file result, remove/replace.
states: Idle, choosing, uploading, uploaded, validation error, network failure, cancelled.
behavior: HSE: state accepted types/size before selection; preserve draft on failure; preview file association and version before submission.
accessibility: Keyboard-operable native file picker; drop area supplemental; accessible progress and per-file errors; no drag-only removal.

name: Evaluation and signoff
anatomy: Person/scope, rubric, evidence, evaluator, result, restrictions, review/submit.
states: Draft, incomplete, ready for review, submitting, signed, rejected, superseded.
behavior: HSE: explicit actor and scope; review consequential result; record server confirmation. Role enforcement is server-side, not inferred from enabled buttons.
accessibility: Grouped inputs, error summary, labels, preserved values. Confirmation communicates exact consequence. Never silently overwrite a signed record.

name: Timeline and version record
anatomy: Event, actor, timestamp with zone, object/version, reason, evidence link.
states: Current, historical, superseded, correction, unavailable evidence.
behavior: HSE: append historical events; show current versus version-at-training; stable export identifiers; show missing data explicitly.
accessibility: Ordered list with textual chronology; dates understandable without visual position; no color-only current-version indicator.

name: Empty, no results and access denied
anatomy: Contextual heading, explanation, permitted next action, optional illustration.
states: First use, zero assignments, no matching filters, no permission, deleted/unavailable.
behavior: HSE: distinguish absence from failed retrieval. No matches offers Clear filters; no assignments explains whether to browse or ask a supervisor.
accessibility: Announce updates in status; heading meaningful; recovery is keyboard reachable; decorative art has empty alt.

name: Loading, failure, offline and conflict
anatomy: Stable content placeholder, state text, retry/reconnect/resolve action, last saved time.
states: Initial loading, refreshing, partial failure, offline, stale, save conflict.
behavior: HSE: preserve last known content with stale label; never show completion until server confirms. Retry must not duplicate submissions.
accessibility: aria-busy on relevant region; skeleton hidden from AT; one polite status; reduced motion; no indefinite spinner without recovery.

name: Toast and save feedback
anatomy: Result text, optional Undo/View action, dismiss if useful.
states: Success, pending, failure, expired message.
behavior: HSE: status confirmation for low-risk saves; persistent error near the task. Toast cannot be the only evidence that qualification changed.
accessibility: Polite live region; do not move focus; important actions persist and are reachable; honor timing requirements.

name: Tooltip, icon and provider identity
anatomy: Consistent SVG icon; optional tooltip; provider name with supporting logo.
states: Default, hover/focus tooltip, image fallback.
behavior: HSE: 20px common icon, 16px metadata, 24px prominent; 1.5–2px consistent stroke recommendation. Provider name remains visible if image fails.
accessibility: Tooltip opens on focus too, Escape dismisses; supplementary content only. Decorative icons hidden; meaningful icon actions named.

name: Learning player and assessment
anatomy: Lesson region, outline, captions/transcript, progress, Back/Next, question/feedback/help.
states: Ready, playing, paused, buffering, answered, correct/incorrect, saved, retry.
behavior: HSE: support text-first instruction and human questions; exact assessment/version recorded; knowledge completion follows assessment and confirmed save rules.
accessibility: Keyboard controls and captions, no autoplay audio, visible focus, understandable assessment feedback; provide accessible timing alternatives.

name: Footer and support
anatomy: Support, accessibility, privacy, terms, contact, version/product identity.
states: Desktop groups, mobile stacked groups, focused links.
behavior: HSE: compact support footer on task screens; fuller navigation on acquisition pages; human help is reachable during learning.
accessibility: contentinfo landmark; descriptive links; logical reading order; do not force users through large link lists before core task content.
